chunks: By no means. He will be thrown into Hutama.

key_terms.الْحُطَمَةِ: A level of Hellfire that consumes or crushes

ai.seo_question: What is Al-Hutama in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Al-Hutama' is often interpreted not merely as a place but as a devouring entity that consumes the inner essence of the disbelievers, reflecting the severity of their spiritual decay. This verse, part of Surah Al-Takathur, serves as a stern warning against the worldly obsession with accumulation, a theme emphasized by Imams like Ali ibn Abi Talib as a distraction from eternal accountability. The imagery underscores the finality of divine judgment for those who prioritize material gain over spiritual truth.
